recentItems.title: Zhang Ruiyang Skates to Madonna's Frozen ❄️🎶 | Milano Cortina 2026
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live all the #MilanoCortina2026 action: https://go.olympics.com/watch 

The People's Republic of China's Zhang Ruiyang took 19th in the women's single skating at Milano Cortina 2026. Skating on Olympic ice, the 18-year-old left her mark with a fierce short program to Madonna's Frozen.

Relive the best moments from the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games, featuring elite athletes, thrilling competition, and unforgettable highlights across the world’s top winter sports on the Olympic stage.

recentItems.title: Margarita Kolosov on Life After Paris 2024 and Team Germany's Strength | Rhythmic Gymnastics Rewind
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live #Paris2024! ➡️ https://oly.ch/3REmN8s

Germany's Margarita Kolosov missed out on a medal by the slimmest of margins, finishing 4th in the individual all-around at Paris 2024. Today she looks back on her performances, and gives us exclusive insights into her life after Paris 2024, plus the scoop on why Team Germany is so strong in rhythmic gymnastics.
